facadePolicy: A class map has to stay one-to-one: both scripts/validate_class_map.py and the porter depend on it to make a rename reversible. R8 merges a facade into its call site's class, so the members the customization calls are mapped by an explicit member pin (or by a reviewed coverage target), and the facade class itself is left unmapped - Lgn;, Lmm;, Lmm0;, Lj23;, Lms6; - rather than crowding a second owner out of the target class.
